content: Six cluster-randomized trials were included in the analysis. The evidence was downgraded once due to potential performance bias, as eight trials lacked blinding. Detection bias was identified in three trials due to self-reported or non-validated outcomes, and attrition bias was noted in one trial. Two cluster-randomized trials were affected by recruitment bias, and one trial experienced loss of clusters. Some domains of bias risk were unclear due to insufficient information from unpublished reports or conference abstracts. In the meta-analysis, Choko (2019a) included multiple intervention arms with HIV self-testing (HIVST) and different linkage interventions. Arms with similar linkage interventions were combined. Choko (2019b) had two intervention arms with HIVST and different linkage interventions, but these arms were not combined. Shahmanesh (2019) also had two different interventions, which were not combined. Chanda (2017) and Ortblad (2017) included multiple intervention arms with HIVST and different kit distribution methods but no linkage interventions; these arms were combined, and the control arm sample was adjusted to prevent double counting.
